inventory_rules.decision: URGENT REORDER: Place a purchase order immediately.
inventory_rules.reason: Current stock is at or below the defined reorder level.

inventory_rules.decision: LOW STOCK ALERT: Monitor stock and prepare a reorder plan.
inventory_rules.reason: The available quantity is 20 units or fewer.

inventory_rules.decision: STOCK STATUS: Current stock is above the reorder level.
inventory_rules.reason: No immediate reorder is required based on the current stock level.

expiry_rules.decision: EXPIRED PRODUCT: Remove the item from sale immediately.
expiry_rules.reason: The expiry date has passed or the product expires today.

expiry_rules.decision: NEAR EXPIRY: Move the item to a clearance section or apply a controlled discount.
expiry_rules.reason: The product will expire within the next 7 days.

expiry_rules.decision: EXPIRY STATUS: No immediate expiry action is required.
expiry_rules.reason: The product has more than 7 days remaining before expiry.

sales_rules.decision: SLOW MOVING ITEM: Consider a discount, bundle offer, or better product placement.
sales_rules.reason: The item has not been sold for 30 days or more.

sales_rules.decision: FAST MOVING ITEM: Maintain buffer stock and review the reorder level.
sales_rules.reason: The item sells at 10 or more units per day.

sales_rules.decision: NORMAL SALES STATUS: Continue regular stock monitoring.
sales_rules.reason: The product is selling within the normal monitoring range.
